description: This PHP class defines an employee language filter field used in reports within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a filter base class and implements value normalization, facilitating querying employee language data and converting language IDs to label representations.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguage
classes.description: A filter field class for filtering employees based on their language skills in reports. It includes methods for adding query conditions, retrieving entity aliases, and normalizing language values.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a filtering condition to the query builder for employee language, based on the operator and value.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the entity aliases used in query joins, specifically 'language'.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Converts the language ID to an array with 'id' and 'label' for display purposes.
